entities.name: Large ribosomal subunit protein bL12
observations: The 128-aa query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt B8J1A7 from Desulfovibrio desulfuricans.
bL12 forms part of the ribosomal stalk and supports ribosome interaction with GTP-bound translation factors.
Annotated localization: cytosolic large ribosomal subunit; associated biological process: translation.
